rationale: OQ-2's ADR-0023 carve-out is narrow, bead 7's ADR-0025 amendment is directionally correct, and ADR-0037 should remain untouched under OQ-1(a). The plan also preserves one load-bearing half of ADR-0041 section 1: the panel gate remains before CommitAll, so reviewed_head_sha and dirty-tree facts are measured pre-mutation. But the proposed reversal does not yet preserve the other half as an enforced invariant. It says the pre-commit worktree measurement is identical to what CommitAll and the artifact-sync commit materialize, while CommitAll itself runs bd export and then git commit (including repository pre-commit hooks), and the plan defines neither an immutable prospective tree nor a post-measurement equality check. A normal ref-to-worktree git diff also does not by itself include untracked files that CommitAll later stages. Consequently a source/doc/ADR path can enter or change after the gates measure and before the commit lands, so the gates can miss just-committed work: exactly the load-bearing failure ADR-0041's old ordering prevented. Calling this measurement equivalence without a mechanism and red-on-revert tests is not yet an honest reversal.
concrete_changes_required: Revise OQ-1(a), ADR Fitness, and bead 6 to define the exact prospective-content mechanism. It must include committed-tip delta, staged and unstaged changes, deletions, and untracked files, and it must guarantee that the source-relevant tree committed after the gates is the same tree they evaluated despite bd export, commit hooks, and intervening worktree changes. A temporary-index/tree-object snapshot committed from the measured tree is one admissible design; an equally strong mechanically checked design is acceptable.

Draft the ADR-0041 section-1 amendment as an explicit replacement of both load-bearing ordering statements: retain panel-before-CommitAll and its reviewed-SHA/dirty-tree rationale; replace doc-sync/ADR-divergence-after-materialization with prospective-snapshot-before-any-complete-authored-commit; state precisely how artifact-only normalization is treated and why the gates cannot vacuously miss content. Remove or qualify the current unsupported claim that the commits materialize exactly the measured content.

Extend bead 6's tests with red-on-revert cases for an untracked source/doc/ADR file and for content changing during the gate-to-commit interval (including a hook/export mutation boundary). The committed source-relevant tree must either equal the measured snapshot or the command must refuse before advancing the bead tip.

Keep the ADR-0025 amendment expressly limited to the worktree-creating `mindspec next` claim path: its entangleable tracked-path enumeration controls when that path blocks, while `approve` and other dirty-tree guards retain their existing semantics unless separately amended.

findings.summary: The plan preserves panel-before-commit but does not mechanically preserve doc/ADR coverage of the content eventually committed. Its measurement-equivalence premise is false or at least unproved across untracked files, bd export, pre-commit hooks, and gate-to-commit worktree changes. The proposed tests only assert unchanged tip on a doc-sync refusal and stale-SHA convergence; they do not prove measured-tree equals committed-tree.

The draft-discovery exception is appropriately narrow: it requires the spec directory plus conventional spec branch, applies only while no lifecycle epic exists, propagates beads/discovery errors rather than treating them as absence, and restores beads-only authority from epic creation onward. It does not make spec.md or plan.md authoritative for post-approval lifecycle state.

Bead 7 correctly prices an ADR-0025 amendment and retains the explicit named-artifact model plus a pinned entangleable-path inventory. The amendment wording should explicitly specialize only the worktree-creating next-claim path; a generic rewrite of decision item 1 to all entangleable dirt could unintentionally relax approve and future guards beyond R5/AC-8.

Leaving ADR-0037 untouched is correct for option (a): section 4 still compares the live bead ref to reviewed_head_sha without exemption, section 5 still evaluates pre-CommitAll dirt, the panel gate remains first, and no new Git/bd/subprocess work is moved into internal/panel. The caller-side prospective doc/ADR measurement is outside ADR-0037's decision matrix.
